activity: Unloading & manual handling of MS sheets/coils (Routine)
hazardDescription: Manual lifting/carrying of heavy sheet metal; sharp/burred edges of sheets
potentialConsequence: Musculoskeletal injury (back/shoulder strain); cuts & lacerations to hands
existingControls: Hand gloves, safety shoes issued; trained store personnel; edge de-burring at inward stage
additionalControls: Provide mechanical handling aids (hydraulic trolley/sheet lifter); edge-protection training refresher; team-lifting SOP for loads >20 kg

activity: Forklift / hand-pallet-truck movement in store & yard (Routine)
hazardDescription: Collision with pedestrians or racking; overturning on uneven surface
potentialConsequence: Struck-by injury to personnel; property damage
existingControls: Trained operator, speed limit signage
additionalControls: Mark pedestrian walkways; install convex mirrors at blind corners; reversing alarm/beacon on forklift; periodic refresher training

activity: Shearing machine operation — cutting MS sheet to size (Routine)
hazardDescription: Hand/finger entrapment at blade; sheet-edge cuts while feeding/removing material
potentialConsequence: Crush injury / amputation of fingers; lacerations
existingControls: Fixed blade guard, two-hand operation switch, cut-resistant gloves (away from blade), trained operator
additionalControls: Verify interlock/guard functioning on periodic PM schedule; refresher training on safe feeding technique

activity: Turret punch press operation (Routine)
hazardDescription: Hand entrapment in punch/die area; ejected metal slug/chip
potentialConsequence: Crush injury to hand; eye injury from flying chip
existingControls: Machine guarding, safety glasses, trained operator
additionalControls: Fixed polycarbonate chip guard at punch zone; mandatory face shield during operation; guard interlock verification

activity: Turret punch press — continuous operation (Routine)
hazardDescription: Continuous machine noise during punching cycles
existingControls: Ear plugs issued
additionalControls: Noise-level survey at operator position; enforce ear-plug/ear-muff use; consider acoustic enclosure if levels exceed 85 dB(A)

activity: Laser cutting machine operation (Routine)
hazardDescription: Direct/reflected laser beam exposure; fire from combustible residue; fume generation
potentialConsequence: Eye injury (retinal damage); burns; respiratory irritation; fire
existingControls: Enclosed laser cabin with interlock, fume extraction system, trained operator
additionalControls: Verify cabin interlock function each shift; fume-extraction system efficiency test; assign trained Laser Safety focal point; keep fire extinguisher (CO2/DCP) at station

activity: Press brake bending operation (Routine)
hazardDescription: Hand/finger crush between punch and die during bending
existingControls: Light curtain / two-hand control, guarding, trained operator
additionalControls: Daily functional check of light curtain before start of shift (checklist); operator refresher training; restrict bystanders from work zone

activity: Arc / MIG welding of canopy & base-frame components (Routine)
hazardDescription: Arc flash and UV/IR radiation exposure to eyes and skin
existingControls: Welding helmet with auto-darkening filter, apron, gloves, welding screens between bays
additionalControls: PPE compliance spot-audit; ensure welding curtains maintained/replaced when damaged; awareness training on arc-flash hazard

activity: Arc / MIG / gas welding — fume generation (Routine)
hazardDescription: Inhalation of welding fume (metal oxides, ozone)
potentialConsequence: Respiratory irritation; long-term occupational lung disease
existingControls: General shop ventilation; some local exhaust at select stations
additionalControls: Install/extend Local Exhaust Ventilation (LEV) at all welding stations; periodic workplace air-quality monitoring; respiratory PPE for confined/poorly-ventilated bays

activity: Operation of welding machines / electrical connections (Routine)
hazardDescription: Electric shock from damaged cables, poor earthing, wet conditions
existingControls: Earthing of welding machines, periodic electrical inspection
additionalControls: Install RCCB/ELCB on welding power circuits; scheduled insulation/cable-condition checks; replace damaged cables immediately (do not repair with tape)

activity: Welding near stored combustibles / packing material (Routine)
hazardDescription: Sparks/spatter igniting nearby combustible material (packing, oil rags, powder coating area)
existingControls: Fire extinguishers in shop, general housekeeping
additionalControls: Implement formal Hot Work Permit system; mandatory fire-watch during/after welding near combustibles; spark-containment screens; maintain minimum clearance from powder-coating/paint areas

activity: Portable grinder use for deburring welds (Routine)
hazardDescription: Abrasive wheel burst; flying particles; hand-arm vibration; noise
potentialConsequence: Eye injury; lacerations; hand-arm vibration syndrome (long-term); hearing loss
existingControls: Wheel guard, face shield, gloves issued
additionalControls: Maintain Abrasive Wheel inspection register (mandatory record); rotate operators to limit vibration exposure duration; noise/vibration exposure assessment

activity: Shot blasting of fabricated parts prior to pretreatment (Routine)
hazardDescription: Airborne dust from blasting media; high noise levels; ricochet of blast media
potentialConsequence: Respiratory illness (pneumoconiosis if silica-containing media used); noise-induced hearing loss; eye/skin injury from ricochet
existingControls: Enclosed blasting cabin, dust collector, PPE (respirator, ear muffs) per WI22
additionalControls: Verify dust-extraction system efficiency (differential pressure check) periodically; confirm blast media is non-silica (steel grit/shot) or provide additional respiratory protection if silica-based; annual audiometry & PFT for exposed workers

activity: Handling/dipping of components in degreasing, acid-pickling & phosphating tanks (Routine)
hazardDescription: Splash/contact with corrosive acid, alkali or phosphating chemicals; inhalation of vapours
potentialConsequence: Chemical burns to skin/eyes; respiratory irritation
existingControls: Acid-resistant gloves, apron, face shield/goggles issued; MSDS available (per SOP-04)
additionalControls: Install and test emergency eyewash & safety shower at pretreatment line; refresher training on chemical handling; maintain spill-containment kit at the line

activity: Working near pretreatment tank line — wet floor (Routine)
hazardDescription: Wet, chemically-contaminated floor around tanks
potentialConsequence: Slip and fall injury; secondary chemical contact from fall onto contaminated surface
existingControls: Floor drainage channels, warning signage
additionalControls: Install anti-skid flooring/mats at tank line; enforce housekeeping schedule (mop/squeegee wet areas each shift)

activity: Fume/vapour generation from heated pretreatment tanks (Routine)
hazardDescription: Acidic/alkaline fume evolution from heated baths
potentialConsequence: Respiratory irritation to operators; air emission requiring MPCB compliance
existingControls: Local exhaust ventilation over tanks; ETP for effluent (per legal register)
additionalControls: Verify LEV hood capture-velocity periodically; confirm exhaust routed through scrubber before discharge; cross-check with Environmental legal register (Air Act consent)

activity: Electrostatic powder-coating booth operation (Routine)
hazardDescription: Combustible powder-dust cloud in booth; static electricity build-up; potential ignition source
existingControls: Booth earthing/bonding, dust collection system, no open ignition sources permitted
additionalControls: Verify explosion-relief venting/panels are unobstructed; periodic static-electricity/earthing continuity test; strict "No Smoking / No Open Flame" enforcement with signage

activity: Powder-coating curing oven operation (LPG/electric fired) (Routine)
hazardDescription: Hot oven surfaces; possible LPG leak (if gas-fired); overheating
existingControls: Temperature controller, oven door interlock
additionalControls: Scheduled testing of oven safety interlocks & temperature cut-off; LPG leak-detection check if gas-fired; hot-surface warning signage

activity: Powder application / booth housekeeping (Routine)
hazardDescription: Inhalation of respirable powder-coating dust
existingControls: Dust mask (PPE), booth extraction
additionalControls: Respirator fit-testing for booth operators; periodic health check-up for exposed workers

activity: Liquid paint / solvent touch-up application (Routine / Non-Routine)
hazardDescription: Flammable solvent vapours; VOC inhalation; contact dermatitis
existingControls: Ventilated area, PPE (mask, gloves), fire extinguisher nearby (per WI38)
additionalControls: Use flameproof electrical fittings in the painting area; store solvents/paint in designated flammable-liquid cabinet away from ignition sources; periodic VOC exposure monitoring

activity: Use of hand/power tools during assembly & foam cutting (Routine)
hazardDescription: Cuts from cutting blades/knives; hand injury from power tools (per Assembly SOP)
existingControls: Cut-resistant gloves, tool guards, trained operators (per SOP/ASSLY/01)
additionalControls: Periodic tool-guard inspection checklist; mandatory PPE compliance check before task start

activity: Manual handling of canopy panels/components during assembly (Routine)
hazardDescription: Lifting/carrying heavy or bulky fabricated panels
potentialConsequence: Musculoskeletal injury; crush injury if panel is dropped
existingControls: Team-lifting practice for larger panels
additionalControls: Provide mechanical lifting aids (chain hoist/jib crane) for heavy panels; formal manual-handling training

activity: Hydrostatic (bund) test of fabricated fuel tank with water — up to 1200 L (Routine, per SPEPR035)
hazardDescription: Water spillage / slip hazard; structural failure of tank/weld joint under test pressure
potentialConsequence: Slip and fall; injury from sudden water release if tank fails; property damage
existingControls: Written test procedure (SPEPR035), barricading of test area, PPE, tank placed on stable/level supports
additionalControls: Maintain a pressure/water-level monitoring log during test; define and mark drainage path for test water; periodic review of technician adherence to SPEPR035

activity: Internal inspection/entry into fabricated fuel tank, if performed (Non-Routine)
hazardDescription: Restricted entry/exit, potential oxygen deficiency or residual fumes inside tank shell
existingControls: To be confirmed with Skyline whether internal tank entry is currently practiced
additionalControls: If internal entry is practiced: implement a formal Confined Space Entry Permit system, pre-entry gas testing, continuous ventilation, standby person and rescue plan. If not practiced, formally prohibit internal entry and state so in the SOP.

activity: Air compressor operation for pneumatic tools & painting/blasting lines (Routine)
hazardDescription: Entanglement in belt/moving parts; pressure-vessel rupture; high noise
potentialConsequence: Serious injury from entanglement; injury from vessel failure; hearing loss
existingControls: Belt/flywheel guarding, periodic statutory pressure-vessel inspection, ear protection issued
additionalControls: Track statutory pressure-vessel test-certificate renewal in compliance calendar; acoustic enclosure/canopy for compressor to reduce noise at source

activity: Electrical panel operation, maintenance & DG-set running (Routine)
hazardDescription: Electric shock, arc flash, or fire from panels/wiring/DG set
existingControls: Earthing provided, work carried out by licensed electrician
additionalControls: Implement formal Lock-Out-Tag-Out (LOTO) procedure for all electrical maintenance; periodic thermographic/electrical safety audit; arc-flash warning labels on panels

activity: Overhead crane / chain-hoist use for heavy fabrication parts, if installed (Routine)
hazardDescription: Load fall; struck-by suspended load; entanglement
existingControls: To be confirmed whether an EOT crane/hoist is installed at Skyline; if yes — trained operator, visual pre-use check
additionalControls: Confirm crane/hoist inventory; obtain/track statutory load-test certificates; daily pre-use checklist; mark exclusion zone under suspended loads

activity: Movement of forklifts/hand-trolleys within plant aisles (Routine)
hazardDescription: Collision between MHE and pedestrians/racking at blind corners
existingControls: Designated walkways, speed limit signage
additionalControls: Physical segregation (barriers/bollards) on high-traffic aisles; convex mirrors at blind corners; periodic MHE operator refresher

activity: General shop-floor housekeeping — scrap, off-cuts, oil/chemical spills (Routine)
hazardDescription: Cluttered walkways; oil/chemical spillage on floor
existingControls: Periodic housekeeping; Safety Policy WI displayed at site
additionalControls: Formal 5S audit schedule with checklist; spill-response kit positioned at each high-risk work station

activity: Fire risk across shop floor (combustible storage, hot work, electrical) (Routine)
hazardDescription: Ignition of combustible material (packing, powder, solvent, scrap) from hot work or electrical fault
existingControls: Fire extinguishers positioned across shop, Fire NOC maintained (per legal register)
additionalControls: Conduct fire drills at least half-yearly; appoint & train fire wardens per shift; display evacuation routes & assembly point signage; verify extinguisher/hydrant AMC records

activity: Loading of finished canopies/generator enclosures onto trucks (Routine)
hazardDescription: Struck-by reversing/moving truck; fall from truck bed/loading platform; manual handling strain
potentialConsequence: Struck-by injury; fall injury; musculoskeletal injury
existingControls: PPE issued, informal ground-guide during loading
additionalControls: Formal wheel-chocking procedure before loading; edge protection/guard-rail at loading bay; trained banksman/signal person for every loading operation

activity: Prolonged desk-based work — office & QA/administration staff (Routine)
hazardDescription: Poor workstation posture, prolonged sitting
existingControls: Standard office furniture provided
additionalControls: Ergonomic assessment of office workstations; awareness on micro-breaks/posture

activity: Use of electrical equipment / extension boards in office (Routine)
hazardDescription: Loose or overloaded wiring/extension boards
existingControls: Periodic informal electrical checks
additionalControls: Eliminate temporary/loose wiring; scheduled electrical safety inspection of office area; portable fire extinguisher in office

activity: Engagement of contract workers for maintenance/civil/housekeeping work (Non-Routine)
hazardDescription: Contract workers unfamiliar with site-specific hazards; uncontrolled entry to hazardous areas
potentialConsequence: Injury to contract worker due to unfamiliarity with hazards; uncontrolled work near live processes
existingControls: Informal briefing to contractors before work
additionalControls: Formal Contractor Safety Induction (mandatory before site entry); Permit-to-Work system for maintenance/hot work/height/confined space jobs; verify contractor's own EHS/PPE compliance & insurance

activity: Site-wide emergency scenarios — fire, chemical spill, medical emergency (Non-Routine)
hazardDescription: Escalation of an incident due to delayed/uncoordinated response
existingControls: Fire extinguishers, first-aid box available
additionalControls: Conduct mock drills (fire, chemical spill, medical emergency) at planned intervals; maintain trained first-aider roster per shift; display emergency contact numbers & assembly point signage at all entrances

activity: Cumulative occupational noise exposure across machine shop (shearing, punching, bending, shot blasting, compressor) (Routine)
hazardDescription: Continuous/intermittent high noise levels across multiple work areas
existingControls: Ear protection issued in high-noise zones
additionalControls: Plant-wide noise mapping/survey; mandatory hearing-protection zones with signage; annual audiometric testing for exposed workers

activity: Heat exposure near curing oven, pretreatment tanks & shop floor in summer (Routine)
hazardDescription: Elevated ambient/radiant heat near ovens and heated chemical tanks, compounded by seasonal temperature
potentialConsequence: Heat exhaustion / heat stress; reduced alertness
existingControls: General shop ventilation
additionalControls: Provide rest breaks & drinking-water points near high-heat zones; awareness training on heat-stress symptoms, especially during summer months

activity: Handling of gauges, weighing scales & measuring instruments (Routine)
hazardDescription: Minor risk of instrument damage or minor hand strain during handling
existingControls: Trained personnel, dedicated calibration area (per Calibration Schedule)
additionalControls: Maintain as-is; continue periodic calibration per existing schedule
